scantlings.assumed: frame, stringer, deck-beam and keel sections; deck, bulkhead and transom plate; bulkhead positions except the transom; damping; HAZ elongation; the GL fracture coefficients scaled to aluminium; the 6 % weld allowance
scantlings.notes: k = E A / L, real (unsoftened); A = stiffener + 3/4 of the plate strip each side; plating shear as panel diagonals A = G t Ld^3 / (2 E a b); hinges kb = E I / h, My = fy Z_el, Mp = fy Z_p with an effective breadth of 40 t; break = average fracture strain over the beam (GL criterion, Scharrer, Zhang & Egge 2002, scaled by elongation). Seam beams use the welded (HAZ) properties.

super.assumed: all deckhouse plate and member sections; no pillars in the main saloon; glass 10 mm; gearbox, jet, tank and outfit weights; engine layout (tandem, two a hull) and CG heights; the payload split (solved to land the CG on vessels.js)
super.sources: levels, openings and arch dimensions: fv.py (her GA and Matt's photographs); engine: MTU press release 23 Jan 2001 (12V 183 TE 94, 1,930 kg dry with mountings); 75 t and the CG: vessels.js (Boats; Matt 31 Oct)
